decision.author: janeyx99
decision.body:
thanks for tackling this! a few comments:

1. please move the check as up as possible and reduce redundant iteration through the list -- it may be good to abstract out this check/combine it with an existing check that already iterates through the tensors.
2. please also fix foreach_tensor_norm_slow in ForeachOpsKernels.cpp and remove the onlyCUDA from the test case. 

foreach_max would also benefit from such a check, but that should go in a separate PR
